items.title: Gibson Area Hospital & Health Services (Illinois)
items.summary: The WallStreet ransomware group claimed an attack on the nonprofit community hospital in Gibson City, Illinois, on September 29.

items.title: Trailer Bridge (shipping & logistics)
items.summary: Brain Cipher listed the US shipping and logistics operator as a victim on September 29.

items.title: McCord & Associates
items.summary: Brain Cipher also claimed McCord & Associates in late September, its second posting this week.

items.title: Polikem (Colombia, industrial chemicals)
items.summary: The Emperador group claimed the Colombian maker of industrial chemical products on September 29.

items.title: 221 victims across 47 groups in one week
items.summary: Leak-site tracking for September 14–20 counted 221 unique ransomware and extortion victim postings from 47 active groups across 46 countries.

ransomware.note: Late-September claims are leak-site postings; victims have not all confirmed an incident.

items.title: AWS confirms permanent data loss in Bahrain region (me-south-1)
items.summary: AWS said damage from the March conflict spanned multiple Availability Zones and exceeded what its regional and multi-AZ services are designed to withstand, and some customer data is unrecoverable.

items.title: Google Cloud us-central1-b zonal outage hits 15 products
items.summary: A single-zone failure starting September 1 at 7:44 a.m. PT affected 15 named products, including Compute Engine, BigQuery and GKE, and lasted 4h08m.

items.title: Forrester: multi-day hyperscaler outages expected in 2026
items.summary: Forrester predicts at least two major multi-day hyperscaler outages this year as providers prioritise AI infrastructure over ageing legacy systems.

outage.note: No new major hyperscaler outage surfaced in the past 2 weeks; the AWS Bahrain data-loss confirmation is the key late-September development.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway zero-days exploited (CVE-2026-88771/88772)
items.summary: CISA added two critical NetScaler ADC and Gateway flaws enabling remote code execution to KEV on September 27 after active exploitation worldwide.

items.title: 10 newly exploited CVEs added in 7 days
items.summary: Ten vulnerabilities across nine vendors, including Microsoft, MikroTik, WordPress and WSO2, were confirmed as exploited in the wild over the last week.

items.title: CVE-2026-49869 exploited for reverse shells and crypto miners
items.summary: Added to KEV after Microsoft reported exploitation used to establish reverse shells, evade defenses, deploy miners and harvest data.

items.title: Adobe zero-day CVE-2026-75650 (Sep 8 KEV batch)
items.summary: Exploitation was first seen September 4, three days before Adobe's September 7 hotfix; it was one of four CVEs, two of them zero-days, added to KEV on September 8.

items.title: CISA adds seven exploited flaws (Sep 2)
items.summary: The batch covered SQL injection, command injection and authentication-bypass vulnerabilities with evidence of active exploitation.

items.title: Deadly monsoon floods across India, Nepal and Thailand
items.summary: Heavy rain from September 25 to 27 triggered landslides and extreme flooding that killed 56 people in India, 14 in Nepal and 8 in Thailand.

items.title: US East Coast cyclone: 200,000 without power
items.summary: A powerful coastal storm on September 25 brought rain and wind from North Carolina to Maine, flooding roads, cutting power to 200,000 customers and cancelling hundreds of flights.

items.title: Hurricane Polo lands in Baja California Sur
items.summary: Polo intensified to Category 5 within 24 hours before making landfall as a Category 2, bringing destructive winds and flash floods.

items.title: Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan, floods Vietnam
items.summary: Typhoon Dujuan affected Japan and caused flooding in Vietnam.

items.title: Borneo wildfire and haze crisis
items.summary: Severe wildfires on Borneo are producing a regional haze crisis with air-quality and transport impacts.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake near New Caledonia
items.summary: Struck 80 km ENE of Tadine on September 25; USGS alert level green, no tsunami.

items.title: M 4.2 earthquake near Wauna, Washington
items.summary: Struck 6 km WNW of Wauna on September 29; USGS alert level green, no tsunami.

physical.note: Hurricane Nolo's Category 4 strike on Hawaii's Big Island earlier this season remains in recovery.
